gloss: snap; click; single sharp snapping sound

definitions.gloss: snap; click; sound of a single sharp snap or click
definitions.explanation: Mimetic word for a single crisp snapping or clicking sound — a rubber band breaking, a clasp latching shut, a finger snap, or a light slap. The single-occurrence counterpart to ぱちぱち (repeated).

examples.japanese: ⟦{輪ゴム|わごむ}→輪ゴム：20399_wagomu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ぱちん⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{切|き}れた→切れる：01936_kireru⟧。
バックル⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ぱちん⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{留|と}まる。
⟦{指|ゆび}→指：01518_yubi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ぱちん⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{鳴|な}らして→鳴らす：02381_narasu⟧⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}いた→引く：01978_hiku⟧。
examples.english: He snapped his fingers to get attention.

notes:
Single-occurrence mimetic for a crisp, sharp snap. Typically used with ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ぱちん⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{切|き}れる→切れる：01936_kireru⟧ — to snap (and break)
- ぱちん⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{閉|し}まる→閉まる：00754_shimaru⟧ — to click/snap shut
- ぱちん⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{鳴|な}らす→鳴らす：02381_narasu⟧ — to snap (fingers, etc.)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ぱちぱち→ぱちぱち：05889_pachipachi⟧: repeated light snapping or crackling (applause, fire); the ongoing form
- バチン: a louder, harder single snap (more impact force)
- カチッ: a mechanical click (e.g. a switch or lock engaging)
